capabilities: log meals by describing them in natural language
analyze food photos to extract nutrition data
save and reuse frequently eaten meals
track daily calorie and macro progress against goals
generate daily food log notes with progress visuals
extras: Data is stored as plain JSON in the vault with notes rendered one-way from it; since 3.0.0 hand-edits to rendered meal notes no longer sync back, and upgrading from 2.x migrates existing notes automatically with backups.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track nutrition, and manual food logging with forms and calculations is tedious.

relations.evidence: Set your OpenRouter API key and nutrition goals
Choose from powerful models like Gemini, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, GPT-5 to analyze your food

summary: AI-powered nutrition tracker that turns meal descriptions or food photos into daily food logs with calories and macros in your vault.
